core_obligations: Separatedness of the system lets the limit be covered compatibly; the diagonal argument identifies the limit of the affines.
Finite presentation approximation: replace the system by an fp one at a finite level without changing the limit (approximation engine).
Descent to Noetherian: affineness of the Noetherian approximation implies affineness of the limit via the affine detection lemma (Serre/chevalley style) with the index shifts made explicit.
difficulty_reason: Separatedness input + finite presentation approximation + descent of affineness to the Noetherian case; three-engine assembly with an honest index-shift bookkeeping.

compared.difference: The sibling is quasi-affineness detection (weaker conclusion); this lemma is full affineness with separatedness input. Both delivered.
The proposition is the integral approximation variant; this lemma is the fp/separated variant. Different hypotheses.
